bluf: Promodo is a performance marketing agency for ecommerce brands, founded 2004, claiming 450+ experts, 3,500+ clients and 7,000+ projects, with no HQ or office in the record despite an about page claiming 5 offices. It leads with SEO and paid search, sells GEO and AEO on top, and publishes heavily: 317 sitemap URLs updated in 365 days and a GEO Benchmarks 2026 study. Twenty clients are named, 13 observed and seven names only, with results claimed in titles. A rival should know its own house practises 1 of 6 tested lines: no Google ads, no LinkedIn ads, no social pixel, no llms.txt, no testing tool.
doing:
Promodo positions as an award winning, Google certified performance marketing agency for ecommerce brands, covering SEO, PPC, CRO, UX/UI, mobile and retention marketing to turn spend into profit: traffic, conversion and retention sold as one contract. The headline claim, 3,500+ clients and 7,000+ projects since 2004 with a 4.8 star Clutch rating, is a volume claim; the about page adds 5 offices and 450+ staff from 25+ countries, yet the record lists no HQ, office location or owner.

The sold mix leads with SEO and Paid Search, both scored 3: Paid Search on a PPC page citing $1.5M+ budgets managed and the Calzedonia feed case at +214% revenue; SEO on an Enterprise SEO Management page claiming +40% first year traffic and the 9 Realms +417% organic case. Five core lines score 2: AI Search / GEO (a GEO and AEO page with an AI visibility audit; a case claiming +351% AI assistant traffic, +551% revenue), CRO (+41% average yearly conversion growth claimed, paired with UX/UI), Data & Measurement (GA, product and cross platform analytics, forecasting, CDP; 20 analytics experts), Email & CRM (four sub solutions; FREETOUR) and Paid Social (COMFY TikTok catalog ads; UDRIVE Meta). Proprietary tools on record: G-MOS by Promodo (ad group automation for automotive ecommerce), Feed Optimizer by Promodo and FeedGen. B2B and retail media score 0.

Its AI posture is GEO and AEO sold with an audit and a benchmark: AI search visibility, advertising on global AI platforms and PPC automation, plus 2026 GEO benchmarks by industry and 15 AI topic URLs in its sitemap. The Horus read marks P1 making, P8 absent (no test of ads inside assistants) and P6 absent.

The record lists no dated moves, news, open jobs or pricing signal, so P5 reads unknown. Conspicuously absent for an agency claiming 450+ staff and 5 offices: any office location, owner, hire or announcement; the freshest evidence is three case studies last modified 2026-09-24.
clients:
The record reads the client type as mixed and the pitch as ecommerce brands; no HQ or home market is on file beyond the Europe region. The industries list spans automotive, consumer electronics, travel, fashion, beauty, fintech, health care, marketplaces and B2B services.

Twenty clients are named, 13 observed and seven names only, from 7 case studies, 9 slugs and 4 testimonials; organic demand leads the mix at 0.25. Organic demand is observed for 9 Realms (+417% organic traffic for a Shopify CBD store, 2026-08-21), Columbia (4× organic traffic, 5× transactions, 2026-04-28), Autodoc (recovery after Google updates), Asaxiy (100,000 5xx errors) and Telemart (SEO and UX/UI, 30% sales growth), the last three also web and commerce. Paid performance is observed for COMFY (catalog ads tested with GA4 data on TikTok, 2026-09-24; also data and social), UDRIVE (leads up 3.4x, automotive platform, 2026-09-24), Motul (costs cut 2x, followers doubled) and monobank. Calzedonia came for commerce (214% revenue growth, Feed Optimizer, 2026-07-09), FREETOUR.com for CRM (+85% email revenue, 400K returned customers, 2026-09-24), Rakuten Viber for web and product (ASO) and Toloka for data (reporting and BI). No excerpts are on record, so these figures are title claims. Names only: Etnodim (N0 though its title credits FeedGen with 196% more conversions), Leobank, Pandora and testimonials Rolls Auto Sales, Tourism Seychelles, Genesis Group AG and Bar Stool Gems. Shared: Calzedonia with webranking and Pandora with work-co.

What the base needs next: the Horus read places Promodo best for KJ1 (the click replaced by the citation) and most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle hollowed out). Clients that came for organic demand and feeds will very likely (moderate confidence) ask for AI citation share next, which its GEO case and benchmarks answer; the SEO and PPC hours behind the observed book are what KJ6 removes.
house: Say and do: the Horus verdict counts 1 of 6 tested lines practised on its own house; five are contradicted. It sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt (15 AI topic URLs in its sitemap); sells paid search with 0 Google ads of its own in the Transparency Center; sells paid social and runs no social ad pixel; sells paid social or B2B demand generation and the LinkedIn Ad Library attributes 0 ads to it (7 ads match the name query across all advertisers); sells CRO with no testing tool detected on its homepage. Publishing cadence is corroborated: 45 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days, 317 in 365, from 788 sitemap URLs, with 123 case studies counted on the 2026-09-29 own site read and five blog posts dated 2026-09-24 including the GEO benchmarks. The stack on Webflow is GTM and CookieYes; no social pixels, test tools or ABM tools; no AI crawlers blocked. No ad samples are on record.
market:
The Horus read puts Promodo at a tailwind index of 7.5, band Neutral, percentile 37, 16:55 on the Solar Arc (dusk, Atum), resilience 34.5. Best placed for KJ1 (the click replaced by the citation, net 0.199, driven by AI Search / GEO and Paid Search) and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers, net 0.199). Most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle hollowed out, net -0.153, driven by Paid Search, SEO and Paid Social) and KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two, net -0.092). Scenario fit: The Walled Oasis at 39/100. It is making P1, P2, P4 and P7; absent on P3, P6 and P8; P5 unknown.

The Monsoon read is 56.3, band Onshore wind, percentile 51: migration 54.8 against displacement 57.8. The sold mix supplies 55 of the index, SEO (12) and Paid Search (8) carrying the most movable hours; the work would go 50% to South and Southeast Asia and 40% to Eastern Europe, automation overlapping 21%. The footprint is inferred: no hub office listed and no onshore claim captured, the about page's 5 offices claim unlocated.
openings:
The strongest judgment is the say and do gap across the sold mix: Promodo sells paid search, paid social, CRO and AI visibility and its own house shows 0 Google ads, 0 LinkedIn ads, no social pixel, no testing tool and no llms.txt, so a rival running its own ads and tests very likely (high confidence) wins the practise what it sells comparison with ecommerce buyers. Falsifier: a later compile finding Promodo ads in the Transparency Center or a testing tool on promodo.com.

Second, the observed book is contestable on proof: results sit in titles with no excerpt on record, so a rival with audited numbers likely (moderate confidence) matches the +417% and 214% claims with fashion, automotive and marketplace accounts; the shared clients Calzedonia (webranking) and Pandora (work-co) already shop. Third, P8 is absent: paid search with no test of ads inside assistants, so the first in its segment to show results there sets the price. Fourth, no public pricing model: an outcome priced offer forces a conversation it cannot have publicly; displacement at 57.8 makes it roughly even chance, low confidence, that clients move on price. KJ6 removes the SEO and PPC hours it leads with.
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, late October 2026: growth below 10% flags cannibalization of the SEO and PPC lines it leads with; above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the KJ1 tailwind.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.
I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the $2B milestone and pricing below $20 CPM would say whether the KJ2 opportunity arrives while its P8 stays absent.
I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, October 2026: output or outcome pricing at a top five holdco would press an agency with no public pricing and unknown ownership.

The case study cadence: three studies last modified 2026-09-24 (COMFY, FREETOUR retention, the automotive PPC platform); a next compile that adds excerpts or a dated move would turn title claims into evidence.
